method.source: Earth Search STAC, sentinel-2-c1-l2a (ESA Collection 1, L2A surface reflectance)
method.grid: native 20 m Sentinel-2 grid; B04/B08 averaged 2x2 from 10 m
method.reflectance: DN * scale + offset from STAC raster:bands (Collection 1: 0.0001, -0.1)
method.pixel_rule: 20 m pixel centre inside the monitoring cell
